accepted.definition: arrival that has been awaited (especially of something momentous)
accepted.simpleMeaning: the moment when someone or something that people have waited for arrives.
accepted.scope: It is not just the act of moving towards a place; it is an arrival people have been waiting for.
examples: The whole town prepared for the coming of the new king.
They waited for the coming of spring.
branchCoverage: arrival that has been awaited (especially of something momentous) -> the moment when someone or something that people have waited for arrives

accepted.definition: lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits
accepted.simpleMeaning: to make something less strong, calm it down and hold it back within limits.
accepted.scope: It is not about being in charge of a company or machine, and it is not about checking that facts are right.
examples: She struggled to control her anger.
The government introduced rules to control prices.
